description_en: Queries the configured scope for resource monitoring
description_zh: 查询设置的资源监控范围
name: DescribeConfigurationRecorder

AccountId.description_en: The ID of the current Alibaba Cloud account

ConfigurationRecorderStatus.description_en:
The resource monitoring status. Valid values:

REGISTRABLE: The resource monitoring feature is not enabled.

BUILDING: The resource monitoring feature is being enabled.

REGISTERED: The resource monitoring feature is enabled.

REBUILDING: The resource monitoring feature is being re-enabled
ConfigurationRecorderStatus.description_zh:
资源监控状态。取值：
REGISTRABLE：未注册。
BUILDING：构建中。
REGISTERED：已注册。
REBUILDING：重新构建中

OrganizationEnableStatus.description_en:
The upgrade status of Cloud Config for an enterprise. Valid values:

REGISTRABLE: Cloud Config is not upgraded for the enterprise.

BUILDING: Cloud Config is being upgraded for the enterprise.

REGISTERED: Cloud Config is upgraded for the enterprise
OrganizationEnableStatus.description_zh:
企业版配置审计升级状态。取值：

REGISTRABLE：未升级。
BUILDING：升级中。
REGISTERED：已升级

OrganizationMasterId.description_en:
The ID of the management account.

This parameter is returned only when the API operation is called by a management account
OrganizationMasterId.description_zh:
企业管理账号ID。

仅当企业管理账号调用该接口时，返回该参数
